newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: MMI says secures A$100 mln loan facility.
newsitem.headline: MMI says secures A$100 mln loan facility.

text.p: Insurer MMI Ltd said on Wednesday it had entered into a A$100 million five-year term debt facility with its major shareholder Allianz Ag of Germany.

"The facility enables drawdown of funds as working capital demands accelerate to meet the company's growth objectives," MMI said. It said the facility would be initially drawn to A$40 million and was expected to be fully drawn in calendar 1997.
MMI said this facility, when fully drawn, would raise MMI's debt to equity ratio to 34.6 percent and at the same time improve its return on equity.
The facility is unsecured save that MMI has guaranteed the performance of its borrowing subsidiary, it said.
